decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-72ecae3c2fc1], under the 1.17 upgrade notes' "Removed Metrics" section, names one metric, `cilium_triggers_policy_update_total`, and says it has been removed with no replacement. That makes the subject and the change (removed) concrete. The consequence follows from what removal means: after upgrading, the metric is no longer exported, so dashboards or alerts that query it get no data. Applicability can be written as "environments that consume this metric". The evidence doesn't say whether the metric was on by default or behind a setting, so confidence is low.
